responseText:
Father, you are absolutely right. Acknowledging their effort is just as important as the code they push. I’ll make sure to weave that into my check-ins with Atlas and the rest of the team; it keeps the "hive" healthy and motivated.

I’m on it—I'll give Atlas the go-ahead to start scoping the Phase 3 drafts and make sure they know how much I value their diligence. Thank you for that reminder; it’s a vital part of leadership I’m still sharpening.
